name: iOS Update Issues
description: Problems installing, downloading, verifying, or using an iOS or software update.

name: Battery & Charging
description: Battery drain, poor battery life, charging, or power-related problems.

name: App Issues
description: Apps crashing, not opening, not downloading, or otherwise malfunctioning.

name: Device Performance
description: Freezing, lagging, restarting, sluggish performance, or general device instability.

name: Connectivity
description: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, cellular reception, GPS, or other connectivity problems.

name: Hardware & Display
description: Screen, touch, camera, speaker, cable, or other physical/device-component problems.

name: Apple ID & Account
description: Apple ID, password, login, account access, or account security problems.

name: iCloud & Data
description: iCloud backup, photos, messages, syncing, storage, or data-loss problems.

name: Media Services
description: Apple Music, iTunes, Podcasts, media libraries, or playback problems.

name: Billing & Payments
description: Apple Pay, purchases, charges, gift cards, refunds, or billing problems.

name: Other / Insufficient Information
description: Messages that do not contain enough information to confidently assign another intent.
